prompt_meta.title: Core Product (GA-grade): Games/Matches — create, discover, join/leave, capacity, approvals, lifecycle states (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0005 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the initial game lifecycle + rules (public/private, approval policy, cancellation rules) proposed by IDE docs.

step_objectives.goal: Implement the 핵심 Playo-like feature: Games/Matches end-to-end, with GA-grade validation, permissions, and tests across API/Web/Mobile.
outcomes: Users can create a game (match) for a sport with time/place/capacity and rules
Users can discover games using filters (sport, time window, homeArea/radius, status)
Users can request to join / leave games; host can approve/deny if required
Capacity enforcement (including optional waitlist) and state transitions work correctly
Web + Mobile flows exist and are localized KO/EN
API contract is documented and stable for future steps (venues, chat, payments)
constraints: IDE chooses exact data model and API shapes but must document in ops/GAME_MODEL.md and ops/API_CONTRACTS.md.
Use existing auth/session and onboarding gating. Users must be onboarded before creating/joining games.
No payments, no venue booking integrations, no chat/messaging in this step.
Location handling should remain privacy-safe and coarse (use homeArea/radius foundation; no precise GPS required).
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running and migrations/seeds are applied
API endpoints for games exist with full tests (create/update/cancel/list/detail/join/leave/approve/deny)
Web UI supports create + list + detail + join/leave and host manage actions; tests cover key gating
Mobile UI supports list + detail + join/leave (create can be included if feasible; if not, document why and ensure parity later)
All lint/tests pass from repo root

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Keep infra fully automated and consistent.
requirements: Detect OS and ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempts as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up; start them if needed.
Apply DB migrations required for game models.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes evidence of docker info + compose status + migration execution
API tests use real DB successfully

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A robust but simple model that can evolve into full GA scope later.
requirements: Game must include at minimum: sportId, title/name, description (optional), startTime, endTime or duration, capacity, visibility (public/private), joinPolicy (open/approval), status lifecycle.
Participants must include roles (host vs participant) and join states (requested/approved/denied/cancelled/left/waitlisted as needed).
Host-only modifications rules must be enforced server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Docs define lifecycle states and transitions clearly
Tests validate role-based permissions and state transitions

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Stable API contract for Web/Mobile and future integrations.
requirements: Endpoints to: create game, update editable fields, cancel game, list games with filters, get game detail, join/leave game, approve/deny join requests (if approval mode).
Filtering should support at minimum: sport, time window, status, and coarse location (homeArea/radius or equivalent).
Add brute-force/abuse mitigation appropriate for high-traffic list/join endpoints (approach chosen by IDE; document).
acceptance_criteria: API test suite covers all critical paths and rejects invalid/unauthorized actions
Capacity enforcement is correct under concurrency assumptions (best-effort in tests)

requirements: Screens/pages for: Games list, Game detail, Create game, Host manage (join requests/cancel).
Join/leave UI reflects joinPolicy and current user state.
Localization: all visible text KO/EN using shared keys/dictionaries.
acceptance_criteria: Web tests verify: onboarding gating -> cannot access create/join until onboarded
Web tests verify: can create and join a game end-to-end with mocked or real API (IDE chooses approach)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Core discovery + join loop on Mobile.
requirements: Screens for: Games list + detail + join/leave.
If Create game is not implemented on Mobile in this step, IDE must document why and ensure the API supports it; create will be mandated later.
Localization: all visible text KO/EN using shared keys/dictionaries.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile tests at least cover: rendering list/detail states and join/leave state management (headless, CI-friendly)
Manual run evidence (documented) shows mobile can load list from local API

requirements: Create ops/GAME_MODEL.md describing schema, states, transitions, permissions.
Create ops/API_CONTRACTS.md documenting request/response shapes and error conventions for games endpoints.
Create ops/GAME_RULES.md documenting product rules: visibility, approval policy, cancellation, capacity, waitlist decision.
acceptance_criteria: Docs match implementation behavior and tests

tasks.name: Ensure infra is running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Start Docker/infra automatically and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Implement game domain model + migrations
tasks.objective: Add models, migrations, and seed adjustments if needed.

tasks.name: API games endpoints + tests
acceptance: API tests pass and cover critical paths

tasks.name: Web games UX + tests
tasks.objective: Implement list/detail/create/manage flows with localization and gating.
acceptance: Web tests pass for gating and core flows

tasks.name: Mobile games UX + tests
tasks.objective: Implement list/detail/join flows with localization and headless tests.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0005.report.json with no placeholders.
